name: Doctor Octopus

moves.name: Tentacle Jab
moves.description: A single arm snaps out to full extension and punches at long reach.

moves.name: Tentacle Slam
moves.description: Two arms hammer down together with wrecking-ball force.

moves.name: Four-Arm Lock
moves.description: All four pincers seize a foe's limbs and hold them still for a round.

moves.name: Pincer Throw
moves.description: Grabs a foe and hurls them into a wall, car or lamppost.

moves.name: Hostage Grip
moves.description: Seizes a civilian and dangles them; heroes with protects-civilians-first must spend a round on Rescue.

moves.name: Debris Hurl
moves.description: Rips masonry or a vehicle loose and throws it.

moves.name: Arm Wall
moves.description: Braces the arms in front of his body to absorb the next ranged or heavy hit.

moves.name: Tower Rise
moves.description: Lifts his body three stories on braced arms, out of melee reach.

moves.name: Wall Scuttle
moves.description: Scuttles along a wall or ceiling to a new position.

moves.name: Recall Arms
moves.description: Mentally summons detached arms back to the harness and reconnects one.

moves.name: Neural Overclock
moves.description: Pushes the harness past tolerance; his next two arm moves gain power and an arm loses integrity.

moves.name: Master Plan
moves.description: Triggers a pre-rigged collapse that buries everyone in the marked zone; only usable in an arena he prepared.

leitmotif: Low, mechanical four-note ostinato in a minor key, each note a different arm; a pompous brass-style lead over it that cracks into dissonance when an arm is lost.
